meta.title: Scenario: merger matrix (Loomwell Group)
meta.notes: Fictional data, generated by scripts/generate-merged-scenarios.ts (merger-matrix) with seed 20261110. A matrix organisation combined with a post-merger company. 34 members. The team attribute holds the function; Engineering and Product came mostly from Eastgate, Sales and Finance mostly from Westmoor (legacy_org). Members below lead level work in three programmes (Harbour, Lighthouse, Pier) that mix functions and legacies; ties within a programme are stronger between people from the same legacy organisation. Eastgate respondents rate generously and Westmoor respondents harshly, by about one scale point. Task disagreement arises inside programmes across the legacy line; personal friction arises inside functions across the legacy line (the conflict layers are enabled). Every rating was given.
